Verify a download

Check the file against the release checksums, from the folder you downloaded it to:

$ sha256sum --ignore-missing -c checksums.txt

On macOS use shasum -a 256 --ignore-missing -c checksums.txt. Each desktop file also has its own .sha256 beside it.

Build provenance attestations start with v1.8.0, so this release has checksums only.
